articles.title: Russia-U.S. nuclear arms control: What is the New START nuclear treaty and why does its expiry matter?
articles.summary: The New START treaty, the final nuclear arms control agreement between Russia and the U.S., is set to expire on February 5. Its lapse, echoing Cold War dynamics, risks an unregulated nuclear arms race, critically impacting global strategic stability. This development necessitates urgent diplomatic efforts to avert proliferation and uphold international security, a key concern for global geopolitics.

articles.title: EU Trade Deal Gives Modi’s ‘Make in India’ Ambitions a Boost
articles.summary: India's trade deal with the European Union is set to provide Indian businesses crucial relief from punishing US tariffs. This strategic agreement significantly supports Prime Minister Modi's ambition to transform India into a global manufacturing and export hub. It underscores India's proactive diplomacy in strengthening key economic partnerships and navigating international trade dynamics for national economic growth.
